summary: Full Stack Developer with 10+ years delivering production UIs and the services behind them for Walmart Global Tech, IBM/AEP, and HCSC, roughly 60–70% front end and the rest backend and operations. Front ends in Angular 18+ (standalone components, signals, TypeScript, RxJS, NgRx, Angular Material) and React with core JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, and CSS/SCSS; backends in Node.js / TypeScript (Express, NestJS) designing and consuming RESTful APIs with versioning, pagination, error-contract and OpenAPI conventions, plus GraphQL, over PostgreSQL and MongoDB. Builds, deploys, and runs applications on AWS (Lambda and serverless, S3, ECS/Fargate and EKS/Kubernetes, RDS, CloudFront) with Docker and GitHub Actions / Jenkins / Azure DevOps pipelines gated by Jest, Jasmine/Karma, Cypress, and Supertest, shipping to end users every two weeks and as often as daily. Owns production support with Dynatrace (cut P1 mean time to resolution by 50%), micro-frontend architecture (Module Federation, Electrode Native), and code review and mentoring in Agile/Scrum teams. Experience in regulated, high-compliance domains (HIPAA healthcare, marketplace transactions). GitHub Copilot and Claude Code in daily use.
